question: which five children showed the biggest jump in situp count between the first and second fitness test

which five children showed the biggest jump in situp count between the first and second fitness test
attempts.response:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS baseline_situps
  FROM "sportathon_baseline"
),
endline AS (
  SELECT "Child ID", "Sit Ups" AS endline_situps
  FROM "sportathon_endline"
),
changes AS (
  SELECT 
    b."Child ID",
    b."Child Name",
    e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS situp_jump
  FROM baseline b
  JOIN endline e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
)
SELECT "Child Name", situp_jump
FROM changes
WHERE situp_jump IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY situp_jump DESC
LIMIT 5;
